selection.priority: Complete the predeclared fixed field-error/gradient diagnostic first. This note authorizes no implementation, training, new jobs, or cutoff sweep.

references.supports: C++ max_level and set_max_level plus per-element GPU pointer; default 1000 disables cutoff.
Current Python-bound native Module exposes no max_level setter.
HashGrid factory does not parse max_level from JSON; adding that key does not activate this control.
Official MultiLevelEncodingLoD is registered through the public encoding factory when forward/backward support is compiled.
Hard LoD wrapper uses one extra input dimension and a multi-level base encoding.
Last input channel supplies per-element level control to the base encoder.
Output dimensions, parameter count and initialization are delegated to the base encoder; wrapper adds no learned parameters.
Cutoff compares level against LOD times number of levels plus 1e-3; inactive outputs and coordinate derivatives are zero and lookup returns early.
Native parameter backward skips inactive levels.
Public native parameter initialization uses the supplied module seed; forward is differentiable through public output and parameter tensors.
Public Encoding accepts a JSON encoding configuration and reports output dimensions.
Grid scale/resolution use base grid vertex resolution and per-level growth; no inferred Composite parameter offsets are needed.

single_conditional_candidate.unchanged_requirements: Both groups must use the same fresh constructor, seed, complete stored parameter tensors, decoder input width, common geometry/query/BC conditions and training recipe. Existing fused checkpoints are not a matched split-encoding control.

official_hard_LoD.public_call_shape: Encoding(4, {otype: MultiLevelEncodingLoD, lod_type: Hard, base: original 12-level HashGrid}); input is xyz plus one fixed nonlearned control scalar
official_hard_LoD.threshold_reason: 0.625*12=7.5: levels0..7 remain active; levels8..11 satisfy level>=7.5+1e-3 and are zeroed. Using 8/12 would retain level8 because of the 1e-3 tolerance.
official_hard_LoD.installed_binary_support: Not instantiated or tested in this source-only review. A future root-authorized single native smoke must verify this public path.

public_output_mask.encoding_forward_cost: All12 levels are still evaluated; a post-output mask does not provide the native lookup savings of Hard LoD.

initialization_and_capacity_limits: Identical stored parameter count and initialization do not imply identical active/effective capacity; four fine levels are deliberately unavailable in coarse8.
Both groups must retain the same full24 hash output and decoder layout; reducing n_levels to8 would change storage/initialization and is a different comparison.
Natural full/coarse predictions need not be equal at initialization because their encoded inputs differ; parity applies to a common identical cutoff/input fixture.
Separate Encoding and Network initialize public parameter tensors independently using supplied seeds; no equivalence to an old NetworkWithInputEncoding flat buffer or RNG sequence is assumed.
continuity_and_gradient_limits: Linear grid interpolation is spatially continuous and piecewise differentiable. A constant mask or constant Hard LoD does not introduce position-dependent level switching.
Inactive fine-level parameter gradients are zero; active levels retain first-order parameter gradients through the public encoder output.

This is a representation-bandwidth control, not a guarantee of a band-limited or low-gradient displacement field: nonlinear decoder, query context and local geometry inputs can still vary at short scales.
It provides no proof of the cause of current P1 errors, physical correctness, or generalization.
performance_limits: Hard LoD has a source-level early return for disabled grid lookups/backward, but still launches level work and wrapper operations; speedup is unmeasured.
Split Encoding plus Network adds public tensor materialization/casts/mask or LoD input preparation and a separate native call compared with the existing fused interface.
No performance numbers, native backward acceptance, or training benefit have been established by this note.
